# Kintsu — Composable Liquid Staking on Monad & Hyperliquid

> Kintsu is a composable liquid staking protocol on Monad and Hyperliquid. Users stake gas tokens (MON or HYPE), receive liquid staking tokens (sMON or sHYPE), and use those LSTs across 60+ DeFi integrations — all while earning staking yield and MEV rewards. Governed by an onchain representative democracy with the KSU governance token. Audited by Spearbit and Nethermind. Built by Water Cooler Studios.

- Stake MON → receive sMON (ERC-20 liquid staking token). sMON is reward-bearing: balance stays fixed, but each sMON appreciates in MON value as staking rewards compound.
- Stake HYPE → receive sHYPE on Hyperliquid. Same reward-bearing mechanism.
- superMON is a curated DeFi yield vault on Monad, managed by top high-frequency traders.
- KSU is the governance token controlling validator delegation weights and DAO evolution.
- 60+ ecosystem partners across DEXes, lending, restaking, perpetuals, and gaming.

## Public APIs

- [APY History API](https://kintsu.xyz/api/public/apy): GET — historical APY data (query: days=1–365, default 30). Returns daily APY values and latest formatted APY.
- [Points Leaderboard API](https://kintsu.xyz/api/public/points): GET — points leaderboard (query: addresses, limit=1–1000, page). Returns ranked point totals.
- [Validators API](https://kintsu.xyz/api/public/validators): GET — validator registry data.
- [OpenAPI Specification](https://kintsu.xyz/openapi): Full API schema in YAML format.

## Smart Contracts

- sMON (StakedMonad) on Monad Mainnet (Chain ID 143): `0xA3227C5969757783154C60bF0bC1944180ed81B9`
- StakedMonad Vault on Monad Testnet (Chain ID 10143): `0xe1d2439b75fb9746E7Bc6cB777Ae10AA7f7ef9c5`
- StakedHype Vault on Hyperliquid (Chain ID 999): `0xDDC126c12F9F8DF5a6fC273f6D43C1E21b4d2945`
- sHYPE Token on Hyperliquid (Chain ID 999): `0xBeF0142A0955a7d5dcCe5C2A13Fb84E332669D2d`
